{{Quote|You talkin' to me, wimp? I don't think you realize where you are. Look around! We're the most wanted killers in the galaxy! Anyone here could rip you limb from limb.|Razak, to the Hunter|<ref name="TOR:ADA" />}}
'''Razak''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] criminal of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] at the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR:ADA" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates" /> Razak went to an auction hosted by [[Bilikin Drell]] concerning the target list of the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]], as he was anxious that he was a bounty. However, he and all that were at the auction were killed by an [[Hunter (individual)|unidentified bounty hunter]].<ref name="TOR:ADA" />
